description: Search the web and return ranked results, optionally scraping each result page with the given scrape options.

country.description: Country code to localize the search results, e.g. 'US'.

lang.description: Language code for the search results, e.g. 'en'.

limit.description: Maximum number of search results to return.

query.description: Search query to run against the web.

scrapeOptions.description: Optional scrape options applied to each result page when scraping search results.

name: firecrawl_search
